7(a).answer_md:
**Computation of Economic Value Added (EVA) of Rajat Industries Ltd. (RIL)**

| Particulars | ₹ in lakh |
|---|---|
| (A) Net operating profit after tax [Working Note (vi)] | 1,293.60 |
| (B) Cost of operating capital employed $= [ \text{Weighted average cost of capital } \times \text{ operating capital employed} ] = [ \text{₹ } 7{,}000 \text{ lakh } \times 13.68 \% ]$ | 957.60 |
| (C) Economic Value Added (EVA) $[A - B]$ | 336 |

**Working Notes:**
(i) Computation of cost of debt:

$$
\text{Cost of debt} = \text{Interest rate}(1 - \text{tax rate}) = 12\%(1 - 0.30) = 8.40\%
$$

(ii) Computation of cost of equity:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Cost of equity} &= \text{Risk-free rate} + (\text{Beta} \times \text{equity market rate risk premium})\\
&= 9\% + [1.5 \times (13\% - 9\%)] = 9\% + 6\% = 15\%
\end{aligned}
$$

(iii) Computation of total capital employed:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total capital employed} &= \text{Share capital} + 12\%\text{ debentures} + \text{Securities premium} + \text{Free reserve} + \text{Capital reserve}\\
&= \text{₹ }4{,}429.60\text{ lakh}\ (4{,}42{,}960 \times \text{₹ }1{,}000) + \text{₹ }1{,}400\text{ lakh}\ (1{,}40{,}00{,}000 \times \text{₹ }10) + \text{₹ }434\text{ lakh} + \text{₹ }431.20\text{ lakh} + \text{₹ }305.20\text{ lakh}\\
&= \text{₹ }7{,}000\text{ lakh}
\end{aligned}
$$

(iv) Computation of weighted average cost of capital:

$$
[(\text{₹ }1{,}400\text{ lakh}/\text{₹ }7{,}000\text{ lakh}) \times 8.40\%] + [\text{₹ }5{,}600\text{ lakh}/\text{₹ }7{,}000\text{ lakh}) \times 15\%] = 1.68\% + 12\% = 13.68\%
$$

(v) Computation of profit before interest and tax:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Financial leverage} &= \text{Profit before interest and tax}/(\text{Profit before interest and tax} - \text{interest})\\
\text{i.e., } 1.1 &= \text{PBIT}/(\text{PBIT} - \text{₹ }168\text{ lakh})\\
\text{or, } 1.1\ \text{PBIT} - \text{₹ }184.8\text{ lakh} &= \text{PBIT};\ \text{or } 0.1\ \text{PBIT} = \text{₹ }184.8\text{ lakh};\\
\text{or } \text{PBIT} &= \text{₹ }184.8\text{ lakh}/0.1 = \text{₹ }1{,}848\text{ lakh}
\end{aligned}
$$

(vi) Computation of net operating profit after tax:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Net operating profit after tax} &= \text{Profit before interest and tax} - \text{tax}\\
&= \text{₹ }1{,}848\text{ lakh} - (\text{₹ }1{,}848\text{ lakh} \times 30\%) = \text{₹ }1{,}293.60\text{ lakh}
\end{aligned}
$$

(vii) Computation of operating capital employed: It is equal to total capital employed i.e., ₹ 7,000 lakh because there are no non-operating assets to be deducted from and no other non-interest-bearing operating liabilities to be added to total capital employed.
